scope.environment: Aave Distributor contract with Merit Rewards distributed via Merkl Merkle-based claim system
evidence: Aave Merit rewards not accounted in claimAaveRewards()
Aave’s new **Merit Rewards program** distributes incentives via a **Merkle-based claim system** (through [Merkl](https://app.merkl.xyz)) instead of the standard `RewardsController`.
Currently, `Distributor::claimAaveRewards()` only calls:
and does not account for Merit rewards, which would need to call `Claim()` on `Angle Protocol: Distributor`.

As a result, users may **miss out on unclaimed Merit rewards**, which expire after **6 months**, leading to permanent loss. Since users could reasonably assume all rewards are handled by `claimAaveRewards()`, this creates a usability and value loss risk.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether claimAaveRewards() is permissionless or restricted; no unauthorized-caller condition is supported.
Report does not establish a prior transaction or pre-existing unclaimed Merit balance before the claim call; the unclaimed-reward state is described as a consequence.
The 6-month expiry is stated as a property of Merit rewards but no specific elapsed-time checkpoint is given.
